title: OrderCancelled
description: Reply to orders.cancel-order: the checkout has no live order. orderId and number are set when an order had been placed and is now cancelled (notifications mails the customer); both are null when no order existed and any later place-order for the checkout will be rejected. Keyed by checkoutId.

orderId.description: Null when no order had been placed.

number.description: The cancelled order's number; null when no order had been placed.

customerId.description: Null when no order had been placed.

email.description: Where the cancellation mail goes; null when no order had been placed.
